**Why:** contract/instance-unreachable-detail/unwrapped-name: The strict-modes check now refuses a symbolic link at the instance directory first, so a symlink reads strict-modes-failed and the row's symlink clause is false.
**Ref:** .andromeda/runs/2026-11-13T21-45-02-wrap/

- Refusal lines — `unable  <name>  <reason>  <detail>` on stderr, then the cause's `hint:` line last (`send` and `answer` print the same hint for the same reason or detail; a `not-delivered` refusal with an opaque detail or none prints no hint); the exit-1 refusals of `run`, `revive` and `verify` and every exit-21 strict-modes refusal use the fixed `unable: <text>` / `hint:` pair instead

- `list` rows escape every control character (C0 with `\n`/`\t`, DEL, C1) as two-hex-digit escape text (`escape_row`); `wait`/`last` text, and a `link` line's `since` that is no RFC 3339 instant, escape C0, DEL and C1 the same way but keep `\n`/`\t`; nothing is stripped. No hint ever names `viola release`; no hint for `unknown`, `wrapper fault`, `internal error` or a `not-delivered` refusal with an opaque detail or none; a refused `viola answer` ends with its own hint for `unknown-dialog` and, for any other named detail, the hint `viola send` holds for it.

- Default-deny: only fields in the obs-plan §6 catalog; veil `#[derive(Redact)]` on every payload type that carries content (`toggle` banned); a payload type with no content field derives neither `Redact` nor `Debug`

- Exit codes: 0 ok · 1 internal / a `run` start refusal (its refused home-tree check before the wrapper log included: the home or the instance pair, no log, no child; its refused socket directory too, `socket_dir_ready` before any snapshot, child or `Server::bind`: the `unable:` / `hint:` pair, or under `viola revive --json` the `socket-dir-refused` document, and one `process-exit{subject:"self", exit_code:1, detail:"socket-dir-refused"}`, no path, pid or uid, a failed create reading the same code and a `Server::bind` failure not), a `revive` strict-modes, home-tree, preflight, socket-directory or start refusal, a `verify` failing row, refusal (its refused home-tree check of the home, `ledger/`, `bin/` and `plugin/` before its `cli` log, and `update_stamps`'s `StampsError::StrictModes`, each the home-state pair, included; a refused home tree writes no line, a failing row carries no code, and every other refusal carries its `Ended::Refused` code, `program-not-found` · `pinned-hash-mismatch` · `version-unreadable` · `strict-modes-failed` · `unclean-fixture`, beside `interrupted`, on the `process-exit` it writes under a parsed `VIOLA_NAME`; `verify` takes no `--json`) or Ctrl-C / TERM stop (no stamp written, `unable: verify was stopped before it finished`), `list`'s `instances/` that cannot be listed or failed log start, the hidden `viola mcp`'s home or `diagnostics/` (each that exists) failing `viola_state::strict::check_path` (nothing on stdout or stderr, no role file) or a stdin line past `MAX_FRAME` before `initialize` (both streams empty, one `parse-rejected{mcp-stdin, oversize, count:1}` line; exit 0 once initialized), `viola wait` / `viola last`'s refusal reply, reply of no known shape or channel error other than a failed connect or a closed / reset connection, `viola link` / `viola unlink`'s refusal reply or an `ok` of another shape than the verb's (`link`: a string `since` and a boolean `already_linked`; `unlink`: an object) · 2 usage (clap, a second positional to `viola send` included; never from `viola hook`), and `viola send` text over `MAX_FRAME` or not UTF-8 (the exit-2 paths of `viola answer` and `viola send` write the fixed `UNUSABLE_RESPONSE` / `UNUSABLE_TEXT` line to stderr whatever `--json` says, and no document) · 10 human-typing · 11 budget-paused · 12 unverified-cli · 13 not-delivered · 14 unknown · 20 wrapper fault (a fault code outside the five reading `{"code": <code>, "message": "wrapper fault", "data": null}` on `--json` and MCP and `error: wrapper fault  <code>` on the human line; a `-32602` from `link` / `unlink` included: a missing, non-string or invalid name, a `driven` that is not the serving wrapper's own name, or a `driver` equal to `driven`, the self-pair refused by the wrapper only, never client-side) · 21 instance unreachable (the `--json` document's `detail` its closed cause: no live endpoint reads `viola_state::liveness::without_endpoint`, a `symlink_metadata` behind the strict-modes check that opens nothing and writes no line, `instance-dead` for an instance directory and `unwrapped-name` for anything else at the instance path (absent or a regular file), a stale wrapper giving no endpoint and so `instance-dead`; `answer_of` reads a failed connect as `instance-dead` and a wrapper lost with the call open as `endpoint-lost`; `src/human/hints.rs` holds the unwrapped-name, endpoint-lost and socket-directory hints, each last on stderr in plain ASCII; on `send`, `wait`, `last`, `answer`, `pause`, `release`, `link` and `unlink` also a server that is not the recorded wrapper (on Unix a connected peer whose euid is not this user's or cannot be read, `peer_admitted`; on Linux the connected peer's pid or OS start time not the snapshot's), or a server check that cannot be made: no frame written, `{"v":1,"error":"instance-unreachable","detail":"server-verify-failed"}` under `--json` with stderr empty, or the `unable  <name>  instance-unreachable` line with the server-verify hint last on stderr; the client's own exit-13 refusals and the strict-modes instance check (exit 21, `client::refuse_untrusted`: the target instance for `send`, `wait`, `last`, `answer`, `pause` and `release`, the driven instance for `link` / `unlink`) and then the socket-directory check on the recorded endpoint (`check_endpoint_dir`, exit 21: no frame, `{"v":1,"error":"instance-unreachable","detail":"socket-dir-refused"}` under `--json` with stderr empty, or the `unable  <name>  instance-unreachable` line with the socket-directory hint last on stderr, one `process-exit` at WARN with `detail` `socket-dir-refused` and `during` `connect`, and no `channel-request`) come first, before any connect, and the cause has no exit code or `RefusalReason` of its own, its `--json` word the document's `detail`), and `viola list`'s refused strict-modes check of the home, `instances/` or any one instance, which refuses the whole board (`--json` `{"v":1,"error":"instance-unreachable","detail":"strict-modes-failed"}`, no log opened), and `viola plugin install`'s refused `check_path` of the home or an existing `marketplace/` tree dir, run before anything under the home is created, written or opened (the same exit and document; human mode the home-state pair; nothing created, no log opened), and `viola link` / `viola unlink`'s refused instance check of the driven instance and `send` / `wait` / `last` / `answer` / `pause` / `release`'s of the target instance (`client::refuse_untrusted`: `check_instance` on the home and `instances/<driven>` or `instances/<name>`, the verb's first step, after its text read for `send`, before any role file or log opens: the same exit and document; human mode the instance-state `unable:` / `hint:` pair; no log opened, no line written, the mode left as found). `viola hook` always exits 0.

- Before the FIRST frame of any method (including `hook.event`), verify the server: pid (+ sysinfo start time) against a `snapshot.json` that passed strict-modes in the same process (the socket-directory, pid, start-time and euid checks, none skipped). `viola hook`'s event and dialog paths run `check_instance` on the canonicalised instance (`canonical`, then `trusted`, in `src/cmd/hook.rs`) before the diagnostics level and obs init; a refused or absent instance exits 0 at once with no `config.json` read, no stdin read, no line and no frame; the two `--capture` arms stay ahead of the check. `verify` checks its home tree (`check_home_tree`: the home, `ledger/`, `bin/`, `plugin/`) before its `cli` log, and its `update_stamps` runs `strict::check_stamps` before it creates `ledger/` and again under its lock (a refusal `StampsError::StrictModes` reads and writes nothing, exit 1 with the home pair); `run`'s version gate reads the stamps through `read_stamps_strict` (a refusal is `cli_verified:false`). No dated strict-modes gap remains: every other frame client runs `check_instance` first, then reads the snapshot through `read_snapshot_or_replay` (a replayed or absent one gives no endpoint and so no frame), then the liveness-only pre-check, the socket-directory check on the recorded endpoint (`check_endpoint_dir`), the connect, the peer euid decision (`peer_admitted`) and the server check — CLI `send` (after its text read), `wait`, `last`, `answer`, `pause`, `release`, `link` and `unlink` through `client::refuse_untrusted`, then `live_endpoint` (the snapshot's pid + start time alive, the heartbeat live, an `endpoint` present; else exit 21, `viola_state::liveness::without_endpoint`'s `symlink_metadata`, which opens nothing and writes no line, reading `instance-dead` for an instance directory and `unwrapped-name` for an absent path or a regular file), then `client::connect` (the socket-directory check on the recorded endpoint, the connect, the peer euid decision and the peer pid and its start time against the snapshot's `pid` and `started_at`); `viola hook pre-tool-use|permission-request` past `trusted` writes its `hook.dialog` frame after its payload shape check through `src/cmd/hook.rs`'s shared `connect`; `viola mcp`'s `send` / `wait` / `last` / `answer` tools through the Tokio client after `check_instance` and `viola_state::liveness::live_endpoint` (else `instance-unreachable` with `detail` `without_endpoint`'s reading, `instance-dead` or `unwrapped-name`) then `check_endpoint_dir` (a refusal `socket-dir-refused`) and, after `TokioClient::connect`, the peer euid decision (a refusal `server-verify-failed`) and the server check. On a strict-modes refusal no frame and no line is written: the CLI frame verbs exit 21 with the instance `unable:` / `hint:` pair (under `--json` the `instance-unreachable` document, `detail` `strict-modes-failed`), `hook` exits 0 with no body, MCP returns `instance-unreachable` with `detail` `strict-modes-failed`. On a refused socket directory, before the connect, no frame is written: the CLI frame verbs exit 21 `instance-unreachable` (under `--json`, `detail` `socket-dir-refused`), MCP returns `instance-unreachable` with `detail` `socket-dir-refused` and writes no line, and `hook` fails open (exit 0, no body, one WARN `hook-decision` carrying `socket-dir-refused`). On a mismatch, a refused peer euid, or a check that cannot be made, no frame is written: the CLI frame verbs exit 21 `instance-unreachable` (under `--json`, `detail` `server-verify-failed`), MCP returns `instance-unreachable` with `detail` `server-verify-failed` and writes no line, and `hook` fails open (exit 0, no body, `hook-decision` carrying `server-verify-failed`); no line or output holds a pid, start time, path or endpoint.

- Home: 0700 dirs, 0600 files via `OpenOptionsExt::mode` (pinned `bin/<version>-<hash>/viola` is 0700); the event log, heartbeat and diagnostics files' owner-only append open never follows a symbolic link (a link at the path is a failed open) and sets 0600 through the open handle; every replaced file goes through the one helper `viola_state::fs::replace_private` (tempfile `persist`), which sets the temp file's mode before any byte is written; the pinned `viola` is never replaced: its absent copy goes through `viola_state::fs::place_private_new` (mode 0700 set before any byte, `sync_all`, the write handle closed, then `persist_noclobber`, never over a present name), and a copy another start placed first is re-hashed before reuse, different bytes left as found. Strict-modes check (mode/owner, ssh StrictModes style) at every entry point that reads `snapshot.json`, `ledger/stamps.json` or `statusline_command`, before its first read or open under the home (`run`, `revive`'s start and `verify` through `check_home_tree` before their log opens, exit 1; `viola list`'s `board::scan` through `check_read` on the home (a home another user may read refused with or without an instance), `check_path` on `instances/` and `check_instance` per instance, the whole board refused, exit 21; the frame verbs through `check_instance`, exit 21; the diagnostics opens through `check_diagnostics`, a refusal a failed open), refusing also a home, instance directory or `diagnostics/` another user can read (any group or other bit, `mode & 0o077 != 0`) and a symlinked `diagnostics/` folder or file, and in `viola plugin install` on its home and each existing `marketplace/` tree dir before anything is created or opened (exit 21); `marketplace/` is no trusted file and its installed `command` is not re-hashed (`marketplace/` is off the integrity set).
